name: knitten
description: Agent Hub routing system for Codex plugins

interface.shortDescription: Agent Hub routing system for Codex plugins.
interface.longDescription: Knitten routes generic Agent Hub workflow intent, path/output destinations, and plugin boundaries for Codex plugins. Durable documents stay with the target workspace, local operational outputs go to the Knitten hub, and payload plugins keep domain-specific behavior.
defaultPrompt: Read SYSTEM.md, keep this plugin self-contained, and use Knitten to route Agent Hub workflow intent, output paths, and plugin boundaries.
